headline: Lukoil Reaches $10 Billion Deal to Sell International Assets Following US Sanctions
summary: An investment consortium including US firm Eldridge agreed to acquire Lukoil's international assets in a $10 billion transaction spurred by US sanctions on the Russian oil company.
why: Lukoil is a major Russian energy enterprise; sanctions-driven divestments reshape ownership of international refining and marketing networks.

impacts.name: Lukoil
impacts.why: Divesting international assets under US sanctions fundamentally alters the company's global footprint.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Sanctions pressure forced a multi-billion dollar asset swap and sale agreement for international operations, changing corporate asset structure.
